testcase.name: Scenario: Keep compact ribbon display when switching document types: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:119:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Keep compact ribbon display when switching document types ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the drawing is active with its ribbon in compact group-button mode ✔ When the user activates the part document ✔ Then the part ribbon displays its command groups as compact buttons ✔ And those buttons include Sketch, Create and Modify ✔ When the user returns to the drawing document ✔ Then its ribbon displays compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons
